tasks.title: Analyze Docker image size breakdown
tasks.description: Run docker history or dive to identify largest layers in the 3proxy-ui Docker image. Document which packages and files contribute most to the 1.3GB size.
tasks.details: Use docker history or dive tool to analyze layer sizes. Identify the largest contributors to image size including node_modules, system packages, and build artifacts. Document findings for targeted optimization.
tasks.testStrategy: Document the largest layers and their sizes. Identify specific packages or files that can be removed.

tasks.title: Remove devDependencies from runtime stage
tasks.description: Modify Dockerfile to install only production dependencies in the runtime stage. Use npm ci --omit=dev to avoid installing devDependencies.
tasks.details: Update the runtime stage of the Dockerfile to perform a clean production-only npm install. This ensures no devDependencies like @types, eslint, jest, puppeteer, typescript, etc. are included in the final image.
tasks.testStrategy: Build the Docker image and verify node_modules size is reduced. Check that no dev packages exist in runtime stage.

tasks.title: Remove unnecessary runtime packages
tasks.description: Evaluate docker-cli and other runtime packages. Remove docker-cli if not needed at runtime, keeping only essential packages for fail2ban and basic operation.
tasks.details: Review the runtime apk add packages (curl, docker-cli, fail2ban, iptables, python3, sqlite-libs). Determine which are truly needed. docker-cli is large and may not be needed if docker socket is mounted. Remove unnecessary packages to reduce image size.
tasks.testStrategy: Build image and verify all features still work (dashboard, user management, proxy testing, fail2ban).

tasks.title: Optimize node_modules in build stage
tasks.description: Ensure aggressive pruning of node_modules before copying to runtime. Remove all documentation, tests, types, and unnecessary files from packages.
tasks.details: Add comprehensive cleanup of node_modules in the build stage: remove @types packages, test files, documentation, examples directories. Use npm prune --production and additional rm commands to strip unnecessary files.
tasks.testStrategy: Run tsc --noEmit to verify no type errors. Build Docker image and measure node_modules size.

tasks.title: Build and verify optimized image size
tasks.description: Build the optimized Docker image and verify the size is at most 900MB. Test that the application starts and all core features work.
tasks.details: Run docker build with the optimized Dockerfile. Check image size with docker images. Start the container and verify: dashboard loads, user management works, proxy testing functions, 3proxy integration works.
tasks.testStrategy: Image size <= 900MB. Application starts without errors. All features verified.

tasks.title: Run tests and validate no regressions
tasks.description: Run the full test suite to ensure Docker optimization did not introduce any regressions.
tasks.details: Run npx tsc --noEmit for type checking and npx jest for unit tests. Verify all tests pass without new failures.
tasks.testStrategy: All existing tests pass. No new test failures introduced.

tasks.title: Update E2E tests with docker-compose.dev.yml base and create test logs
tasks.description: Update E2E test infrastructure to use docker-compose.dev.yml as base, create realistic 3proxy test logs for validation, and ensure traffic data is correctly recorded in DB with proper BigInt handling. Add unit/integration tests for traffic parsing with test logs.
